title: Neuroscience and neurocircuitry of substance use disorders
html: There has been an increase in the global prevalence and incidence of substance use disorders (SUDs). The global negative impact of the same has been substantial. Considerable morbidity and mortality have been associated with SUDs, in addition to its major societal and quality of life impacts. Considering the role dental clinicians play in dental and other orofacial pain management, it is highly desirable that the impact of the use of potentially addicting medications be reviewed by the dental community.
